name: hmo1
label: HMO improves the quality of care

questions.text:
The health care system is changing rapidly with more and more people being treated in Health Maintenance organizations (or HMOs) and in managed care plans. How much do you agree or disagree with how the HMOs and managed care plans are working? 
A. They improve the quality of care.
questions.stem: The health care system is changing rapidly with more and more people being treated in Health Maintenance organizations (or HMOs) and in managed care plans. How much do you agree or disagree with how the HMOs and managed care plans are working?
questions.item: A. They improve the quality of care.
